spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (गोमयति)
To smear, to anoint.

f. (-का)
A gadfly.
E.
गो a cow, and मक्षिका a fly: stinging cattle.

n. (-लं)
The earth, the globe.
E.
गो, and मण्डल sphere.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Possessing herds, rich in cattle.
f. (-मती)
The name of a river, the Goomtī, in the province of

Oude.
2

A prayer or formula of the Vedas, to be repeated during expiation for killing a cow.
E.
गो a cow or water, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-का)
A tractable and good cow.
E.
गो a cow, मतल्लिका excellence.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्वं)
Slender in the waist.
E.
गो a cow, &c. मध्य middle: repeated.

m. (-न्तः)
1 The name of a mountain.
2 An owner of cattle.
3 A herd of cattle.
E.
गो the earth, मन to mind, झच्^1 aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161123. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/321.

Cowdung.
2

The property or nature of a cow.
E.
गो a cow, and मयट् affix of relation or comprehension.

n. (-त्रं)
A mushroom, a fungus.
E.
गोमय cowdung, and छत्र a Catta or parasol.

f. (-का)
A kind of fungus or mushroom.
E.
कन् and the fem. form added to the preceding.

n. (-यं)
A sort of grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.)
E.
गोमय cowdung, and प्रिय favourable to.

f. (-त्था)
A kind of beetle found in cowdung.
E.
गोमय cowdung, and उत्थ what rises or is generated.

m. (-वः)
Cassia fistula.
E.
गोमय, and उद्भव born, produced, requiring manure.

m. (-युः)
1 A jackall.
2 A kind of Gandharba or celestial musician.
3 The bile or bilious humor of the cow.
E.
गो sound, &c. मा to measure, and उण् Uṇādi affix, य inserted, or गो a cow, and मायु bile.

n. (-नं)
A pair of cattle.
E.
गो, and मिथुन a couple.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Rich in herds, &c.
m. (-मी)
1 The owner of cattle.
2 A jackall.
3 A worshipper.
4 An attendant on a Buddha.
E.
गो a cow, &c. मिनि aff.

m. (-लः)
Name of a Muni.

m. (-नः)
A sort of fish, the bull-fish.
E.
गो, and मीन a fish.

n. (-खं)
1 A house built unevenly or crookedly, viz. with angles, projections, &c.
2 A kind of musical instrument, (a sort of horn or trumpet?)
3 Spreading unguents, plastering, smearing.
4 A hole in a wall made by thieves, &c a breach.
m. (-खः)
1 A shark.
2 A kind of Yakṣa; according to the Jainas, a demigod subservient to their deified saints.
nf. (-खं-खी)
A cloth-bag, containing a rosary into which the hand is thrust to count the beads.
f. (-खी)
The chasm in the Himālaya mountains through which the Ganges flows, erroneously conceived by the Hindus to be of the shape of a cow's mouth.
2 A river in Bengal.
E.
गो a cow, and मुख face, having the face of a cow, &c.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
Stupid as an ox.
E.
गो, and मूढ foolish.

n. (-त्रं)
Cow's urine.
E.
गो, and मूत्र urine.

f. (-का)
1 A kind of grass, described as growing in corn fields, of a reddish colour, and eaten by cattle, commonly Tāmbāda (तांवड.)
2 A verse the second half of which repeats nearly all the syllables of the first.
3 A form of calculation.
E.
गो, मूत्र urine, कन् affix; operating on cows as a diuretic.

m. (-दः)
A yellow gem: see the next.

mn. (-कः-कं)
1 A gem or precious stone brought from the Himālaya and Indus, described as of four sorts, white, pale yellow, red, and dark blue, perhaps varieties of agate.
2 A kind of poison: see काकोल.
3 Smearing the body with unguents.
E.
गो the eye, मिद to anoint, &c. affix घञ् and कन्.

m. (-भः)
Chalcedony or opal.
E.
गोमेद, and सन्निभ what resembles.

m. (-धः)
The offering or sacrifice of a cow.
E.
गो a cow, and मेध sacrifice.
